summary: Semantic, accessible list of raffle entries, in the order provided.
whenToUse: Showing participants and their ticket numbers.
Highlighting a winner already determined by the application.
whenNotToUse: Reordering entries or picking winners at random.

props.name: entries
props.description: Items to display, in the order provided.

props.name: winnerLabel
props.description: Visible text for an entry marked as the winner.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message shown when the list is empty.

inherits: HTML attributes of <ul>. RaffleEntry: id, name, entryNumber?, detail?, avatar?, isWinner?.
accessibility: Uses a ul/li list with a configurable accessible name.
The winner is indicated by text as well as color.
Avatars are decorative and hidden from screen readers.
responsive: Long names and details wrap; numbers and markers stay distinct.
customization: Uses the theme's --dc-* tokens; className and the list's HTML attributes are forwarded.
commonMistakes: Using the list to manage or persist entries: it is a presentational component only.
limits: Does not handle sign-ups or random selection.
